verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost pixel-identical. Each places MERRY/DISCOUNT in the middle band with the illustrations scattered around it. Shared flaws: the green heart creature is cropped at the top edge. The holly is jammed against the red monster. DISCOUNT runs almost into the ghost creature on the right. The bottom group of monsters and gifts is crowded and overlapping, while large dead areas sit around the tree and the headline. The only difference is a gift stack shifted a few pixels, which doesn't change the result.
